title: HTTP Communication Between Services
description: Make one microservice communicate with another via HTTP, handle errors, and manage timeouts.

steps.title: Service A calls Service B
steps.description: Service A receives a request at GET /aggregate, calls Service B at http://localhost:3002/data, and returns the combined result.
hints: Use axios or built-in http module in Node to call Service B
Service A listens on port 3001, Service B on port 3002
Combine Service B's response with Service A's own data and return as one response

steps.title: Service B endpoint
steps.description: Create Service B with a GET /data endpoint that returns some data. This is the downstream service that Service A calls.
hints: Return JSON data with some sample content
Use app.get('/data', handler) returning a simple object

steps.title: Error propagation
steps.description: When Service B returns an error (e.g., GET /error), Service A should propagate it as a 502 Bad Gateway.
hints: Service B should have a /error endpoint returning 500
Service A catches the error from its downstream call
Service A returns 502 with the error details

steps.title: Timeout handling
steps.description: Add a timeout to Service A's call to Service B. If Service B takes longer than 2 seconds, Service A returns 504 Gateway Timeout.
hints: Use AbortController in Node or a timeout option in HTTP clients
Service B should have a /slow endpoint that delays by 5 seconds
Set the timeout to 2 seconds on the client side
